## Formalism

Math renders natively, which matters for the POMDP and search formalism. The
PUCT selection rule used in the self-play agent:

$$
a_t = \arg\max_a \left[ Q(s_t, a) + c_{\text{puct}} \, P(s_t, a)
\frac{\sqrt{\sum_b N(s_t, b)}}{1 + N(s_t, a)} \right]
$$ {#eq-puct}

Reference it later as @eq-puct.

## Encoding

```{python}
#| label: fig-reward
#| fig-cap: "Reward shaping over episode length. Replace with real data."
#| code-fold: true

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

steps = np.arange(0, 200)
dense = 1 - np.exp(-steps / 60)
sparse = (steps > 150).astype(float)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.2))
ax.plot(steps, dense, label="shaped")
ax.plot(steps, sparse, label="terminal only", linestyle="--")
ax.set_xlabel("step")
ax.set_ylabel("cumulative reward")
ax.legend(frameon=False)
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
```

@fig-reward is generated at render time and cached in `_freeze/`. CI never
executes it.
